title: Violations; penalty.
bodyText: Any seller who violates the provisions of section 249-14.2 or 249-14.5 may be fined not exceeding $500.
bodyHtml: §249-14.6  Violations; penalty.  Any seller who violates the provisions of section 249-14.2 or 249-14.5 may be fined not exceeding $500. [L 1974, c 105, pt of §2; am L 1998, c 188, §3]
